privacyAuthorityPacket.scope: MISSION-MATCH-1 changes who is admitted to a seat-less co-op mission match after a spectator joins, and who receives a player's sealed Move, Attack and Physical declarations before the reveal. Both are authority and privacy decisions on the authoritative multiplayer server.
authorityChanges: Membership mode is decided once, by usesRosterMembership(seats) in MatchSeatMembershipSource: a match with no playing seats (absent, empty or spectator-only seats) keeps deriving playing membership from the durable playerIds roster. A playing-seat grid keeps the existing seat membership and lobby-invitee rules.

A spectator occupant derives its own membership from its spectator seat, owns no forces, and still receives spectator-cannot-act for commands. Admission of an unregistered stranger is unchanged (refused).

A rostered player can no longer register as a spectator in a roster-mode match: POST spectate returns 409 and leaves the match unchanged, so the first spectator call cannot evict or demote the roster.

The membership epoch covers roster membership in roster mode and every spectator occupancy change: a spectator join changes the epoch without revoking roster members, a repeat join leaves it stable, and removing a roster member changes it and revokes that member.
privacyChanges: sideOfPlayer(assignments, playerId) answers the first assignment of that one player. Sealed delivery asks whether the viewer is on the actor unit's side; before, the first-listed player of a side was its only owner, so a second player on the side was denied its own declaration and the first-listed one saw it live.

Owner policy (owner decisions 2026-10-26 item 1): teammates on a side see each other's sealed declarations live. Opposing players and spectator seats receive only the public locked frame until the existing authoritative reveal, live, on replay and on reconnect.
The spectator-seat guard still runs first, so neither a GM brand nor a stale side assignment can turn a spectator seat into an owner. A non-spectating GM keeps its existing delivery.
unchanged: S5-02: the spectate door still checks no membership; any authenticated principal can still register as a spectator on a match it is not in.
Mission GM viewer role: coopMissionCreate still omits meta.coopCampaign, so the real mission GM is a player-role viewer. A2M discloses it (Root ruling option a).
Fog and visibility keep their two first-entry-per-side owner readers; fog admission and per-unit command ownership (U38) are untouched.
Command admission, Forfeit and grace expiry keep first-assignment-per-player semantics through the shared function (compatibility rows).
residualRisks: Side assignments are trusted host-written data. A player whose first assignment names the actor's side sees that side's sealed declarations; this unit adds no writer for assignments.
A match already locked out by the old first spectate call is not migrated; the fix prevents the lockout, it does not repair stored seats.
Evidence is Jest on the real route, host and SQLite plus the A2F built runner; the live stale-first row on the built image belongs to the A2M matrix and the RC rerun.

privacyAuthorityPacket.agentRecommendation: Accept only after independent exact-head authority and privacy review, required CI and OWNER-RULING. At the GREEN head the focused suite passes 28 of 28, the 17 neighbour suites pass 228 of 228, and 17 of 17 mutants are killed (M17, the replay path, only by the replay/reconnect rows); tsc, oxfmt and oxlint exit 0, and the A2F built runner passes all eight cases with its 21-call witness sequence. Review three things. Membership: roster mode applies only when there is no playing seat, spectators own no forces and a rostered player cannot register as a spectator (409). Epoch: it covers roster and spectator occupancy, so a spectator join does not revoke the roster and a roster removal does. Sealed delivery: ownership is the viewer's own first side assignment compared with the actor unit's side, teammates see each other's declarations live by owner policy, and opposing players and spectator seats, including a stale first assignment or a GM brand, wait for the reveal on live, replay and reconnect. This does not decide S5-02, the real mission GM role, fog owner semantics or per-unit command ownership. The live stale-first row on the built image belongs to the A2M matrix. No exact-main acceptance is claimed.
